reasoning: This is a system status-bar indicator for 'no cellular signal' (an empty signal wedge with an X), which is OS interface chrome representing a device state rather than a concrete task object. Outside a phone status bar it is easily misread as a geometric triangle or drafting tool, and very few real to-do items have 'no cell signal' as their central subject.
